title: Dispatch a refresh and see its PR merge itself
goal: A dispatched refresh PR merges itself after check passes and its branch is deleted
acceptance: gh workflow run "Refresh solution views" opens or updates the refresh PR; it merges after check passes with no agent action; chore/refresh-solution-views is gone afterwards
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
validation: The PR's merge event and the deleted branch, read with gh
escalation: Repository settings are the owner's: ask before changing them
Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one dispatch and a wait. Not a measurement. 2026-11-25: refresh PR #32 merged itself but left chore/refresh-solution-views (delete_branch_on_merge was false). Owner turned on delete_branch_on_merge 2026-11-25. Verified 2026-11-25: dispatched run 45625090928, guard ok, auto-merge on PR #34, which merged itself at 13:36:31Z after check passed; the branch then returned 404.
